category_title: Shy students with limited verbal output who require prompting to communicate ideas
scenario_title: Adding detail to characters in a whole-class setting
minimal_context: The student is in a whole-class setting using an iPad app to narrate a story and add details to a character.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are going to narrate the story for the class. Please add some detail to the main character.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What else can you tell us about him?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know. Someone else can do it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to add one more detail to the incident.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We are going to narrate the story for the class. Please add some detail to the main character.

STUDENT: He is tall.

TUTOR: What else can you tell us about him?

STUDENT: I don't know. Someone else can do it.

TUTOR: Just try to add one more detail to the incident.

STUDENT: He walked.

task.content: Adding detail to a character or an incident and narrating the story
task.learning_goal: To make his sentences more complex and put expression into his voice

context.materials: iPad app (Our Story), photos, video features
context.social_setting: Whole-class situation, allows others to take the lead

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When asked to add detail to a character or an incident without being given choices
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Will only speak in short sentences and does not add detail

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Allows others to take the lead. He needs encouragement to engage.
